load_and_transform_audio_data: load audio files and transform them into normalized mel spectrogram tensors for model input
load_and_transform_vision_data: load image files and transform them into normalized tensors resized to 224x224
load_and_transform_text: tokenize a list of text strings into BPE token tensors using a simple tokenizer
load_and_transform_video_data: load video files, sample temporal clips, and apply spatial cropping to produce video tensors
waveform2melspec: convert an audio waveform tensor into a mel-frequency spectrogram with padding or truncation
